selection_rule: Use replicate 02 from the same three region-size strata as H1. These cases were frozen in the earlier G6 registration and were never run because G5 failed.
candidate: Frozen H1 genuine-HGS population archive with exact ReSETP re-ranking; the best exact elite is then selected across three route-cost views.
paired_control: The ordinary proxy-best individual from each exact same HGS run.
gate: All nine pairs must be feasible and non-worsening. Across the three cases, the best exact archive across views must strictly improve the best proxy-returned solution on at least two cases; no case may worsen.
no_rescue: Do not alter cases, seed, runtime, views, archive limit, completion, or pass rule.
Do not inspect replicate 03 if H2 fails.
One seed group is fresh directional confirmation, not formal statistics.
claim_boundary: Fresh China81 cases but one seed and three strata only. Passing authorizes multi-seed confirmation, not the full 81-instance experiment.
